package.name: dronehacks_pathfly
package.description: Flies the path from github.com/jsun4231/path-planning through the skybeta flight interface: lift off to 0.2 m, follow the path while climbing to 1.25 m, touch down at its end, climb to 2 m, fly straight back over the take-off point (66.6 deg clockwise of the nose; heading held throughout by default, optional turn first), touch down there. Velocity (twist) setpoints only.
